paragraphs: At shift handover, patrol the well and read gauges, checking pressure and separator liquid level. In the morning, adjust the choke to stabilize backpressure and draw a sample to assess sand content. When SCADA issues an afternoon alert, go to the site and vent the line. Later, grease the pump unit and complete the maintenance ledger. During night shift, watch the flow curve and adjust parameters whenever it fluctuates to keep production stable.
